question: What metric is used to evaluate PolyReponse system?
title: PolyResponse: A Rank-based Approach to Task-Oriented Dialogue with Application in Restaurant Search and Booking
answer_short: It ranks a large index of text and visual responses according to their similarity to the given context.
answer_rationale: Text 5 and Text 4 both state that the PolyResponse engine ranks a large index of text and visual responses based on their similarity to the given context, which is the primary metric used to evaluate its performance in the conversational search task.
